unsafe_reasons.detail: handoff record field `verified` must be a JSON list when present (got int: 5) -- every per-entry check below assumes it can iterate this field as a list, and Python would otherwise either crash iterating a non-iterable value (e.g. an int) or silently iterate a JSON string character-by-character (a genuinely malformed field masquerading as an honestly empty one); treat as unsafe until independently, manually re-verified
